answer: Adoption-lag threshold roster: each attestation cohort rotates its cipher shares every epoch and burns the old ones, while a newcomer's share is adopted only at the next boundary, leaving it a canyon of one full round it can never backfill. The knoll roster is the frozen set of co-signers whose shares proved each round's history, so a sybil minting a thousand addresses holds zero past shares and cloning adds no weight. The only route to influence is corrupting an existing member: history cannot be forged backward, only aged into.
